name: Nuxt SplitType
body: A **Nuxt module** for **SplitType** that splits text into lines, words or characters. Use it as a **`useSplitText` composable**, a **`<split-text>` component** or a **`v-split-text` directive**.
Adds a **`wrapping` option** that wraps each line, word or character in an element of your choice, and a **callback** for the SplitType proxy. The README marks it as pre-v1.
